feedback: The confession follows the two strongest pre-vote clues: Robin possessed the bottle contents and falsely relocated an encounter documented in Grant's private room. The precise later use of the glass is newly stated as the confessed act, rather than a new evidential rescue; the released service timing already allowed it. The response that the claimants never authorized this violence adds welcome moral consequence and makes the motive more human than a generic ideological grievance. Elle and Monet's admissions also give their lies satisfying separate destinations. I found the solution earned, with the caveat that the exact transfer remained inferential until confession. The finale closes emotional debts without pretending that solving the murder repairs the institution.
